items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: So the three of us, we went with Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: He was in Harry's band. That's when Duke Ellington was there at that gambling place -- what is it -- Las Vegas. I used to go and see him, I was with Harry James in one club and Duke was at another club, so I used to go there between intermissions, and he asked me to see if I could get -- what's his name -- Louis. He asked about me, to get me, and I said 'Well, how about Willie Smith too?' So the three of us, we went with Duke Ellington.
So Duke asked you first, and then he asked you to get Louis and then you asked him about Willie? I never knew how that happened, whether Duke just went and took all three of you at once, or what.
